narratives.body: AllNigeriaSoccer reports that a French-born Super Falcons-eligible forward has joined Chelsea on a professional deal.
narratives.headline: French forward joins Chelsea

narratives.body: London Evening Standard reveals that Emi Martinez's injury timeline has been disclosed, while BeSoccer Livescore notes Penders has been given an opportunity following Martinez's injury.
narratives.headline: Emi Martinez injury and Penders opportunity

narratives.body: Football London reports that Estevao received brutally honest transfer advice despite Xabi Alonso's promise, and Football London also notes a Chelsea wonderkid sent Xabi Alonso an 'awesome' message.
narratives.headline: Estevao transfer advice and wonderkid message
